author: KEXP
description:
Madrid-based band Aiko el grupo strike listeners with frenetic punk-pop energy in our latest Live on KEXP session from Biblao, Spain. With host Albina Cabrera, they share a performance of "wormz" and more.

Watch the full session on our YouTube channel.
title: Aiko el grupo perform "wormz" & more Live on KEXP
